title: Vacuum Runtime Log Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vacuum:runtime
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by device_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when vacuum runtime log data has stopped arriving for a given device.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per device and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your vacuum runtime log feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
